verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a 700+ catalog of pre-built connectors covering applications, databases, event streams and files. The connectors are maintained: they handle schema changes, API updates and incremental syncs automatically. Directory entries span SaaS, databases and self-hosted systems, and the Connector SDK fills gaps. Community users independently say no one has as complete a catalog and credit Fivetran with absorbing third-party API changes. Missing for 10: no hands-on evidence on how consistent connector depth and quality are across the long tail of the catalog.
